executiveSummary: During the October 2026 monthly monitoring cycle, we conducted comprehensive storefront testing for the Integrity Reforestation Tree Contribution Widget on the newly activated Horizon theme (v4.2.0). Testing covered product pages, native dialog cart drawers, and cart pages across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports. In addition, we executed end-to-end read-only regression testing on the Integrity Custom Admin Dashboard.

themeUpdateLog.summary: Shopify released maintenance updates for its modern theme collection. We audited Craft (v16.1.0), which is currently active on this store.
themeUpdateLog.testedNote: Horizon (v4.2.0) is actively published on this store. Full Tree Contribution Widget compatibility, dynamic cart math, and multi-device responsive testing were executed — visual evidence and results on the following pages.

devTeamSection.summary: Development work completed this month, as reported by the development team.

items.title: Resend Email option for failed emails
items.description: Added a Resend Email option for failed emails in the Email Logs module. The resend was tested by sending a test email, and the team confirmed it works as expected. Screenshots: Dashboard https://app.screencast.com/Gnxy0jnOdvJch ; Email Inbox https://app.screencast.com/sFe7hbaJw0C6N
items.impact: Failed notification emails can be sent again from the dashboard without re-creating them.

items.title: Beyond theme compatibility
items.description: Added compatibility for the Beyond theme for the Tree Contribution widget.
items.impact: The widget works on stores using the Beyond theme.

items.title: Staging environment for the app and dashboard
items.description: Staging set up for the app and dashboard on Heroku, with a separate database copied from live (live was not changed). Shopify, API, authentication and dashboard connections configured; an authentication issue after merging was fixed. Staging dashboard: https://integrity-staging-dashboard-e835e93f2351.herokuapp.com
items.impact: Future changes can be tested on staging before they go to production.
